description: This Java class 'Builtin' contains embedded API description data in XML format, representing built-in API entries for various Java and Android classes. It is designed to provide predefined API information within the project, possibly for validation or documentation purposes.

classes.name: Builtin
classes.description: Class containing 'built-in' API description entries, with a static method to retrieve the API data as a StringReader.

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a StringReader over the embedded API XML string.
